Class GrundyRecPerdEtGagn

java.lang.Object
GrundyRecPerdEtGagn
class GrundyRecPerdEtGagn extends Object
Grundy's Game. This version 2 improves efficiency by storing not only losing positions but also winning positions in two separate arrays (`posPerdantes` and `posGagnantes`). This avoids unnecessary recursive calculations by directly checking if a position is already known before proceeding. Positions are normalized before being added to the arrays to simplify comparisons and searches.

    • estPerdante

      boolean estPerdante(ArrayList<Integer> jeu)
      RECURSIVE method that indicates if the configuration (of the current game or test game) is losing. This method is used by the machine to know if the opponent can lose (100%).
      Parameters:
      jeu - current game board (the state of the game at a certain moment during the game)
      Returns:
      true if the configuration (of the game) is losing, false otherwise

    • enlever

      void enlever(ArrayList<Integer> jeu, int ligne, int nb)
      Splits a pile of matches into two piles. The new pile is necessarily placed at the end of the list. The pile that is split decreases by the number of matches removed.
      Parameters:
      jeu - list of match piles
      ligne - index of the pile to be split
      nb - number of matches REMOVED from the pile during the split
